comment: ADR 0055 name palette — DIABETIC DIAGNOSIS cohort analytics (RULED by Sunny 2026-08-24; retail vetoed). Fully synthetic. Cell logic is domain-independent; swapping this file re-skins the whole corpus with no code change.

PATIENTS.description: Master patient index for the synthetic diabetic cohort.

columns.ACTIVE_FLAG: 1 when the patient is active in the panel.

columns.PATIENT_ID: Patient the order was placed for.

ENCOUNTER_DIAGNOSIS.description: Diagnoses coded on outpatient encounters (PCP lego).

columns.ENCOUNTER_ID: Encounter the diagnosis was coded on.
columns.DX_CODE: ICD-10 code assigned on the encounter.

HOSPITAL_ENCOUNTERS.description: Hospital encounters, ED and inpatient (ED/IP lego).

columns.HOSP_ENC_ID: Hospital encounter the diagnosis belongs to.
Hospital encounter the order belongs to.

CPT_CODES.description: CPT rows attached to billing transactions.

columns.PATIENT_ID: Patient the code was billed for.

PROCEDURE_ORDERS.description: Procedure orders linked to OR cases.

columns.CASE_ID: OR case the order belongs to.

DIAGNOSIS_CODESET.description: Foundation reference vocabulary: ICD-10 incl. E08-E13 and O24.4x (gestational).

LAB_CODESET.description: Foundation reference vocabulary: lab tests incl. HbA1c and glucose.

MED_CODESET.description: Foundation reference vocabulary: medications incl. insulin/orals (metformin caveat).

CPT_CODESET.description: Foundation reference vocabulary: CPT procedure/billing codes.

dx_path.description: Patients identified as diabetic through coded diagnoses: any E11-family (type 2 diabetes) ICD code on the diagnosis record.

lab_path.description: Patients identified as diabetic through laboratory evidence: a hemoglobin A1c result at or above 6.5 percent.

registry.description: The maintained diabetes registry: patients formally enrolled in the registry table with an enrollment date.

registry_v1.description: The retired first-generation registry pull, kept for comparison: enrollment plus an activity filter the current registry dropped.

controlled.description: Share of diabetic patients whose most recent A1c is under 8.0 — the in-control portion of the population.

controlled_m.description: The controlled-diabetes share computed per calendar month, for trending rather than a point-in-time rate.

a1c_compliance.description: Diabetic patients with at least one A1c test in the measurement window — testing-cadence compliance, not result values.

twin_reporting.description: Actively managed diabetic patients: coded diagnosis joined to an active-status flag, the reporting team's cut.

twin_reports.description: Actively managed diabetic patients as published by the reports schema — same name as the reporting cut, independently maintained.

roster.description: A flat roster of diabetic patients for outreach lists: identity fields only, one row per patient.

dm_list.description: A patient list for diabetes-management workflows; duplicates the roster logic under a different name.

snapshot_a.description: Point-in-time count of registry enrollment, produced by the reporting schema.

snapshot_b.description: Point-in-time count of registry enrollment, produced by the reports schema; whitespace-only variant of the reporting version.

ref_forms.description: A probe exercising every table-reference form the parser must chase: views, synonyms, temp projections, and qualified joins.

pcp_root.description: Diabetic patients on a primary-care panel: the shared base cohort the panel-scoped variants extend.

u1_noshow.description: Panel diabetic patients who missed their primary-care appointments — the outreach-priority slice of the panel.

u2_ed_overlap.description: Panel diabetic patients who also appear in emergency-department visits — care happening outside the panel.

u3_preop.description: Surgical candidates with abnormal diabetes labs before their operation date — the pre-op safety check.

u4_high_ed.description: Patients with heavy emergency-department use and no assigned primary-care provider — unmanaged high utilizers.

u5_incl_gest.description: Diabetic patients counting gestational diabetes codes as qualifying — the inclusive obstetric reading.

u5_excl_gest.description: Diabetic patients excluding gestational diabetes codes — the chronic-condition reading of the same population.

u6_billing.description: Patients billed with diabetes-related procedure codes — the finance view of the diabetic population, built from claims rather than clinical records.

u7_registry.description: The composite registry definition: a patient qualifies by meeting at least two of the three paths — coded diagnosis, A1c at or above 6.5, or diabetes medication orders.

u8_med_derived.description: A registry cut derived from medication orders alone: metformin or insulin glargine implies membership.

u9_codes_80.description: The hand-maintained diabetic ICD code list (80 codes) and the patients it selects — the authoring team's copy.

u9_codes_81.description: The hand-maintained diabetic ICD code list (81 codes) and the patients it selects — one code newer than the sibling copy.

u11_missed.description: Appointments with a no-show status, counted at the appointment grain for schedule management.

u11_noshow.description: Patients who missed appointments, one row per patient — the panel view of the same no-show activity.

u12_patients.description: High emergency-department utilizers counted as DISTINCT patients — how many people exceed the visit threshold.

u12_visits.description: High emergency-department utilization counted at the visit level — how many qualifying visits occur, same name as the patient-grain cut.

chain_linear.description: A linear care cascade: each stage filters the previous one from identification through outreach to follow-up.

chain_diamond.description: An outreach funnel whose branches split from one base and re-join — the diamond dependency shape.

chain_self.description: A panel rollup built stepwise over its own prior stage — the self-referencing chain shape.

dynamic_sql.description: An ad-hoc extract assembled as dynamic SQL at run time; its query text is not statically parseable and is declared as such.

multi_stmt.description: A refresh procedure of several sequential statements; the final select defines its output.

crlf_a.description: A line-ending normalization control: identical logic to its sibling except carriage returns.

crlf_b.description: A line-ending normalization control: identical logic to its sibling except line feeds.

phi_probe.description: A deliberately planted patient-name literal, existing so the PHI scan proves it fires.

cte_descriptions.A1c_High: Patients whose A1c results exceed the control threshold.
cte_descriptions.A1c_Tested: Patients with at least one A1c test in the window.
cte_descriptions.Abnormal_Labs: Lab results outside the acceptable pre-operative range.
cte_descriptions.Active_Now: Patients carrying an active status flag today.
cte_descriptions.Alias_Form: Reference probe: the aliased table-reference form.
cte_descriptions.Ambig_Form: Reference probe: a deliberately ambiguous bare reference.
cte_descriptions.Arm_Dx: The diagnosis-code arm of the comparison pair.
cte_descriptions.Arm_Lab: The lab-criteria arm of the comparison pair.
cte_descriptions.Base_Cohort: The starting patient pool this procedure filters from.
cte_descriptions.Cascade_B: Care cascade stage two: outreach on the identified.
cte_descriptions.Cascade_C: Care cascade stage three: follow-up on the reached.
cte_descriptions.Coded_Cohort: Patients selected by the explicit ICD code list.
cte_descriptions.Composite: Patients meeting at least two of the qualifying paths.
cte_descriptions.Crlf_Cohort: Line-ending control cohort — logic identical to its twin.
cte_descriptions.Ctrl_Pop: The controlled sub-population: most recent A1c under 8.0.
cte_descriptions.Direct_Form: Reference probe: the directly named table form.
cte_descriptions.Dx_Path: Patients qualifying through coded E11-family diagnoses.
cte_descriptions.ED_Symptom_Visits: Emergency-department visits in scope for overlap.
cte_descriptions.Enc_Recent: Encounters within the recent activity window.
cte_descriptions.Enrolled: Patients enrolled in the registry table.
cte_descriptions.Funnel_Join: The rejoin of the funnel's split branches.
cte_descriptions.High_Util: Patients or visits above the utilization threshold.
cte_descriptions.Lab_Draws: Lab draws relevant to the measurement window.
cte_descriptions.Lab_Path: Patients qualifying through A1c results at or above 6.5.
cte_descriptions.Med_Path: Patients qualifying through diabetes medication orders.
cte_descriptions.No_PCP: Patients with no assigned primary-care provider.
cte_descriptions.Reach_Base: The outreach funnel's shared base population.
cte_descriptions.Reg_Core_v1: The legacy registry membership core with its activity filter.
cte_descriptions.Rx_Current: Prescriptions active in the current window.
cte_descriptions.TempChase_Form: Reference probe: projection through a temp table.
cte_descriptions.Unique_Form: Reference probe: the uniquely named reference form.
cte_descriptions.Utilizers: The population exceeding the visit-count threshold.
cte_descriptions.Dx_Events: Diagnosis events feeding the refresh or probe.
cte_descriptions.Refresh_Pop: The population assembled by the refresh statement.
cte_descriptions.Rollup_R: The recursive rollup stage over its prior pass.
cte_descriptions.Phi_Filter: The probe filter deliberately carrying a patient-name literal.
cte_descriptions.A1c_Pool: The pooled A1c results the reference probe draws from.
